title: Daysmith: Launch week daily log
content:
Quick context:
- Sprint: launch-week for v1.3 inference optimizations (latency and routing changes).
- Goal today: lock PRD edits, confirm canary rollout gating, clear blocker list for Dedicated customers on staging, and triage any regressions from latest runtime patch.

Top-of-day TODO (priority order)
1) PRD edits: finalize tenant-specific routing section (see inline comments). ACTION: rewrite fallback paragraph to clarify semantics for regional vs cost routing. Due EOD.
2) Canary checklist: get final sign-off from SRE + Platform. If green, start canary at 14:00 PT.
3) Stakeholder follow-ups: ping CS about customer onboarding docs (Amy), confirm legal has signed off on new telemetry (Jared).
4) Launch playbook: reconcile console screenshots (Rina) + small UI copy tweak for quota error.
5) Move-to-launch decision: run low-latency regression suite at 11:30; if >1.5x p50 we halt.

Notes-to-self / scratchy items
- PRD edits I keep putting off: the metrics table needs clearer SLO names (p50 token latency vs p95 inference endpoint). Maybe split into performance vs reliability sections.
- Reminder: mention quantization profile recommendation as optional (customers may disable).
- Add short script snippet for how to toggle routing policy via API (example).

Meetings (today)
- 09:15 sync w/ Diego (serving-runtime) — status: OK, but Diego flagged a KV-cache edge case when sequence_length > 4k. He'll ship a hotfix by 17:00; we should hold canary until validated in staging.
  - TODO: ask Diego for test vector that reproduces case.
- 10:00 PM/CS sync (Amy) — CS preparing onboarding checklist for Dedicated customers; wants a short blurb about expected token costs per hour for 8-gpu pool. Need to provide sample numbers.
- 11:30 infra regression run (scheduled) — want automated report emailed to #launch-day. If any p95 regression > 10% open a P0.
- 13:00 design walkthrough (Rina) — finalize modal copy for quota warning.
- 15:30 stakeholder rollcall (execs) — send a crisp 1-pager by 12:30.

PRD edit highlights (to resolve)
- Routing policy language: current text ambiguous about fallbacks between region and model-variant. Change to: "Fallback order: same-region compatible model variant -> cross-region compatible model variant -> lower-tier model variant (with notice)".
- Can we document exact cost delta when falling back to lower-tier? ask Finance for cost-per-token estimates for fallback scenarios (linked ticket).
- Add an explicit rollback window for canary: 30 mins observation, automated rollback if latency > baseline by 20% or error rate increase > 1%.

Canary checklist (working)
- Preconditions: staging runs green on smoke for 48h (DONE), infra hotfix applied to KV-cache (pending), metric alerts configured (DONE).
- Scope: 5% of host traffic routed to variant v1.3-canary, only for internal accounts.
- Observability: streaming logs to temp-bucket, dashboards pinned, paging policy for SRE.
- Rollback criteria: latency p95 +20%, token error rate +1% absolute, or any crashloop on nodes.
- Communication: announce in #launch-day 30 mins before.

Blockers and risks
- KV-cache edge case from Diego — medium risk; blocks canary until hotfix validated.
- Billing calc for Dedicated customers still uncertain — need finance numbers for CS onboarding doc.
- Small UX copy change could be missed and become confusing at launch (Rina to push final by 12:00).

Follow-ups / Who I need to ping
- Diego Morales (eng): test vector + ETA for hotfix (send Slack after 09:30).
- Amy Li (customer success): sample cost table for 8-gpu pool (need by 15:00).
- Jared (legal): confirm telemetry ok for customer-managed keys (add to legal checklist).
- Rina Sato (design): console screenshots + final copy (12:00).

Micro-tasks (5–15 min wins)
- Update PRD section header names (performance vs reliability).
- Add note to runbook about how to abort canary via API call (curl example).
- Draft the 1-pager for execs — 3 bullets: status, risks, ask.

Mental checklist (notes to self)
- Keep language non-technical for CS docs but preserve links to technical runbook for SRE/SE.
- Don't ship canary before KV-cache fix validated; we can soft-launch behind feature flag if needed.

Loose ideas / brainstorming (do later)
- Add a small opt-in telemetry toggle customers can use to exclude PII before sending traces (low-effort, high ROI). Worth prototyping after launch.
- Explore lightweight cost-estimator widget in console that uses per-model throughput profiles (maybe part of Optimize next quarter).

End-of-day quick capture (will fill at EOD)
- What shipped?
- What blocked?
- Who to follow up with tomorrow?

Raw links / refs I keep copying into docs:
- Jira: PROD-482 (routing policy)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/948
- Runbook draft: Confluence / PROD/Launch Day Runbook

Tiny capture (12:05): hotfix from Diego looks small (patch to cache eviction). Staging cluster applying now. If validation passes, move canary to 14:00 but still wait for infra regression run results.

Thought for 17:00: if canary shows minor latency bump but no error increase, discuss traffic ramp plan vs hold.
note_summary: Daily PM scratchpad for launch-week: PRD edits, canary checklist, meetings, blockers, quick tasks and follow-ups. Draft status; contains action items for eng, CS, legal, design.
